en: Black‑and‑white view of a small European town taken from a grassy foreground. A simple wooden bridge with a low railing crosses a stream or small river. Behind the bridge stand trees and, further back, tightly packed houses with steep gabled roofs. Dominating the background is a church tower topped with an onion‑shaped dome and cross. On one of the buildings near the center there is a painted commercial sign in German. The upper left corner of the image is missing or overexposed, suggesting damage or cropping of an old photographic postcard or plate.
